sloka: महाबाहुम् महोरस्कम् सिंह विक्रांत गामिनम् ।नृसिंहम् सिंह संकाशम् अहम् रामम् अनुव्रता ॥३-४७-३५॥
transliteration: mahābāhum mahoraskam siṁha vikrāṁta gāminam ।nṛsiṁham siṁha saṁkāśam aham rāmam anuvratā ॥3-47-35॥

translations.english: I am the faithful wife of the longarmed, broadchested Rama, a lion among men. His gait is the gait of an advancing, invincible lion.
